title: Telling stories
intro: Everyone loves a good story: what happened on the way to work, a funny moment with a client, life back home. Learn the tenses that make stories clear, words that move them along, and how to react when someone else is telling one.
introBn: গল্প বলার জন্য অতীতের তিনটি tense, ঘটনার ক্রম বোঝানোর শব্দ, অতীত অভ্যাস আর শ্রোতা হিসেবে প্রতিক্রিয়া দেখানোর ইংরেজি শিখুন।

units.title: Narrative tenses and sequencing
units.idea: Stories use three past tenses together: past simple for the main events, past continuous for the background, past perfect for something that happened earlier. Sequencing words guide the listener.
units.ideaBn: গল্পে মূল ঘটনা past simple, পটভূমি past continuous, আর আগের ঘটনা past perfect। first, then, eventually দিয়ে ক্রম বোঝান।

formula.name: Background
formula.pos: It was raining and I was waiting for a bus.

formula.name: Main event
formula.pos: Suddenly a rickshaw stopped and the driver called my name.

formula.name: Earlier event
formula.pos: I had left my phone in the office.

uses.rule: Past continuous sets the scene; past simple interrupts it.
uses.bn: চলমান পটভূমি past continuous, হঠাৎ ঘটনা past simple।
uses.ex: I was presenting when the power went off.

uses.rule: Past perfect = earlier than another past event.
uses.bn: অতীতের আরও আগের ঘটনা past perfect।
uses.ex: When I arrived, the meeting had already started.

uses.rule: Sequence with first, then, after that, eventually.
uses.bn: ক্রম বোঝাতে first, then, after that, eventually।
uses.ex: First we got lost, then the car broke down, and eventually we arrived at midnight.

uses.rule: Just as = at exactly the same moment.
uses.bn: ঠিক সেই মুহূর্তে বোঝাতে just as।
uses.ex: Just as I was leaving, my boss called me back.

uses.rule: Eventually = in the end, after a long time; not 'possibly'.
uses.ex: Eventually, Rafi found a flat near his office.

traps.wrong: When I reached, the bus already left.
traps.right: When I got there, the bus had already left.
traps.why: Earlier event needs past perfect; reach needs an object.

traps.wrong: I was knowing her since school.
traps.right: I had known her since school.
traps.why: Know is not used in continuous forms.

traps.wrong: Eventually it will rain, so take an umbrella.
traps.right: It might rain, so take an umbrella.
traps.why: Eventually means in the end, not possibly.

drills.s: I ___ dinner when the guests arrived.
By the time we got to the cinema, the film ___ started.
___ I was locking the door, the phone rang.

o: While I walked to work, I was seeing an accident.
While I was walking to work, I saw an accident.
While I was walking to work, I was see an accident.
While I walk to work, I saw an accident.
drills.a: While I was walking to work, I saw an accident.

drills.q: শেষ পর্যন্ত আমরা রাত দুটোয় বাসায় পৌঁছালাম।
o: Eventually, we got home at 2 am.
Eventually, we reached to home at 2 am.
Possibly we got home at 2 am.
At last time, we reached home 2 am.
drills.a: Eventually, we got home at 2 am.

drills.s: First we checked in, ___ we went straight to the beach.
It ___ raining heavily, so we stayed inside.

drills.q: Pick the best sentence for a story.
o: When I arrived, everyone had gone home.
When I arrived, everyone has gone home.
When I had arrived, everyone go home.
When I arrive, everyone had gone home.
drills.a: When I arrived, everyone had gone home.

drills.q: আমি অফিসে পৌঁছে বুঝলাম যে চাবি বাসায় ফেলে এসেছি।
o: When I got to the office, I realised I had left my keys at home.
When I reached office, I realised I left my key in home.
When I got to the office, I was realising I have left my keys at home.
Reaching office, I realised I had forgot keys at home.
drills.a: When I got to the office, I realised I had left my keys at home.
drills.x: Past perfect for the earlier action.

units.title: Reacting and remembering
units.idea: Good listeners react: No way! Really? What happened next? Use used to and would to talk about past habits, especially in stories about childhood or old jobs.
units.ideaBn: ভালো শ্রোতা প্রতিক্রিয়া দেখান: No way! Really? What happened next? অতীতের অভ্যাস বলতে used to আর would।

formula.name: React
formula.pos: No way! · Really? · You're joking! · Oh no! · That's amazing!

formula.name: Ask for more
formula.pos: What happened next? · So what did you do? · And then?

formula.name: Past habits
formula.pos: I used to live in Rajshahi. · Every Eid we would visit my grandparents.

uses.ex: "I met Shakib Al Hasan at the airport!" "No way!"

uses.rule: Ask questions to keep the story going.
Used to + verb: past habits and past states that are no longer true.
uses.bn: আগে ছিল, এখন নেই: used to + verb।
uses.ex: I used to hate coffee, but now I drink three cups a day.

uses.rule: Would + verb: repeated past actions, not states.
uses.bn: বারবার করা কাজের জন্য would; অবস্থার জন্য নয়।
uses.ex: In summer we would swim in the Padma every afternoon.

uses.rule: Negative and question: didn't use to / Did you use to…?
uses.ex: Did you use to play cricket at school?

traps.wrong: I am used to go to school by bus.
traps.right: I used to go to school by bus.
traps.why: 'Be used to' means be accustomed to.
traps.bn: be used to মানে অভ্যস্ত; অতীত অভ্যাসে used to।

traps.right: I used to live in Rajshahi.
traps.why: Would is not used for states.

traps.wrong: I didn't used to like tea.
traps.right: I didn't use to like tea.
traps.why: After didn't, use the base form.

drills.q: Your friend says she won a trip to Japan.

drills.s: Rafi ___ to play football every evening in Rajshahi.
"Then the boss walked in." "Oh no! What happened ___ ?"

o: When I was a child, I would have a dog.
When I was a child, I used to have a dog.
When I was a child, I was used to have a dog.
When I was a child, I use to had a dog.
drills.a: When I was a child, I used to have a dog.
drills.x: States need used to, not would.

drills.q: ছোটবেলায় প্রতি শুক্রবার আমরা নানুর বাড়ি যেতাম।
o: When we were kids, we would visit our grandmother every Friday.
In childhood, we were going to grandmother's house every Friday.
When we were kids, we are used to visit our grandmother every Friday.
When we were kids, we would visited our grandmother every Friday.
drills.a: When we were kids, we would visit our grandmother every Friday.

drills.s: Did you ___ to live in Chattogram?

drills.q: Pick the most natural listener reaction to bad news.
o: It is sad news, I am informing.

drills.s: I didn't ___ to enjoy reading, but now I love it.

o: Really? So what did you do?
True? After that what you do?
Really? So what you have done?
drills.a: Really? So what did you do?

mastery.s: I ___ on the phone when the fire alarm went off.
She was upset because she ___ the bus.

o: I would live near the river as a child.
I used to live near the river as a child.
I am used to live near the river as a child.
I use to lived near the river as a child.
mastery.a: I used to live near the river as a child.

mastery.q: ঠিক যখন আমি বের হচ্ছিলাম, বৃষ্টি শুরু হলো।
o: Just as I was leaving, it started to rain.
Just when I leave, rain is started.
Just as I left, it was starting raining.
Eventually I was leaving, it started rain.
mastery.a: Just as I was leaving, it started to rain.

mastery.s: "I lost my passport in Bangkok." "___ What did you do?"
We waited for hours, and ___ the flight took off at midnight.
